context: A teacher walks a teen through cultural studies
purpose: Teach: 不全/悪循環/転移/結核/抗生/天文学/否認/思い知らさ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦後の機能不全、社会構造、論文で、本気で、扱いましたね、立派な、研究、できました、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Sakura — your paper on post-war dysfunction and social structures was genuinely impressive work. Truly splendid research.
lines.style: Warm approval with professorial weight. Steady, deliberate pace. Clear-eyed recognition—not effusive, but genuine. Slight pause before 'splendid' to let the compliment land.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。差別の悪循環、論文で、論じました、現代にも、繋がる、テーマでした、本気で、絶対、深い、研究、できました。
lines.en: Yes. I explored the vicious cycle of discrimination in the paper—how that theme connects to the modern day. It was serious, deep research.
lines.style: Focused and earnest. Measured tempo, each thought building. Quiet conviction in her voice. No rushing—she's thinking as she speaks, present to what she's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、人々が、地域に、強制転移させられた歴史、論文で、本気で、扱っていましたね、本当に、感動的でした。
lines.en: The history of forced relocations during wartime—you handled that with real care in your paper. It was moving to read.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tender. Slightly slower pace, as if honoring the weight of the subject. Soft finish on 'moving'—not performative, genuinely moved.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦後、結核療養所の歴史、論文で、扱いました、本気で、辛い、歴史でした、絶対、忘れずに、いきたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I covered the history of tuberculosis sanatoriums in the post-war period. It was painful history, and I want to make sure we don't forget it.
lines.style: Steady determination underlying the quiet delivery. Deliberate on the phrase about not forgetting—it matters to her. No hesitation, but not rushed either.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時、海外からの抗生物質、本気で、貴重でしたよね、論文で、扱っていましたね、桜さん、本気で、立派、絶対。
lines.en: The antibiotics that came from overseas during that era were so precious—and you addressed that thoughtfully in your paper. Really excellent work, Sakura.
lines.style: Engaged and specific. Warm recognition threading through. Unhurried—she's speaking to the quality of the thinking, not just checking a box. Slight upward lilt on 'excellent'.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。当時の天文学者、戦中、本気で、貢献されましたね、論文で、扱いました、本当に、感動的な、視点でした、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The astronomers of that era contributed so much during wartime, and I addressed that in my paper. It was such a moving perspective to explore.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised at her own insight. Pace is steady but contemplative—she's still processing the significance of what she discovered. Genuine wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争責任の否認、戦後、本気で、長く、続きましたね、論文で、丁寧に、論じていました、桜さん、本気で、立派、絶対。
lines.en: War responsibility denial continued for so long after the war—and you discussed that with real nuance in your paper, Sakura. Genuinely thoughtful work.
lines.style: Reflective and careful. Deliberate phrasing—the words themselves carry weight. Not rushed. A slight pause before 'thoughtful' to emphasize the quality of her thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦争の重みを、本気で、思い知らされた、研究でした、本当に、深く、勉強、できました、絶対、感謝、しております。
lines.en: Yes. This research really brought home the weight of war itself. I studied deeply, and I'm grateful for what this work has taught me.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slower, more measured than before—she's moved, almost solemn. Soft finish, like she's speaking something she really means. Steady breath.
